a: An unsecured loan is not secured on any asset. It does not require a guarantor. Your loan will be confidential in so far that you don’t have to discuss it with anyone, other than us to make an application to borrow from loans by mal.

We base the amount you can borrow on your monthly income, with a minimum loan of £1,000 up to a maximum loan of £5,000. We can lend up to 2x your income. This can include your salary, self employed income and your pension.

q: Will my repayment amounts alter every month?
a: No. Your repayments are fixed throughout the term of the loan. This gives you the security of knowing at the outset what you are paying each month.
